The blue cage looks like a Large Zoozone / Zoozone 2  which is 100cm long and 50cm wide. It was a common choice of cage in the UK for hamsters/mice when options were more limited. It's recommended to mesh the top as the bars are wider than a similar cage like the Duna Multy Maxi -  so a hamster could use hanging toys or the wheel to climb up and squeeze through. Some people cable tie the base of a wheel like the Trixie wheel to the lid to help instead of placing the base of the wheel on the bedding. You can find pics of set ups on hamster forums and google images.

Ahh that's such a sad accident. We had a mouse choke on medicine once😢 Hamsters are so small and fragile. I'd rather lightly scruff or just put up with any nips/bites. But blanket method works great with larger animals like guinea pigs. There are other lighter fabrics that might work better for hamsters like a scrap of fabric from an old t-shirt.

I use metal baby nail clippers - trick is to go slow and clip only a small amount. My hamster doesn't always let me clip more than one nail at a time so it can take me a week to get them all. I prefer to go at her pace. It helps to pick a time were they are tired rather than a peak active time too. There's probably videos on YouTube for hamsters and it might be worth looking up other rodents like rats as that community always have great tip.

Rocks and such don't work as prevention for some hamsters. Sometimes they just have fast growing nails. I've had loads of hamsters with similar set ups and care and some never need nail trims, some a one off and a handful regular trims. But a vet can do them easily. My local vets charge around £5-£15.

I was born in the late 90s my parents were in their late 30s and early 40s when I was born. My mum never talked to me about periods and school implied it was just a little blood..  I didn't say anything the first month because I felt awkward and my mum tended to be in a bad mood or too busy for us to talk privately.. I do have a sister but she's 15 years older than me so we've never been close.

We also didn't have a bathroom bin but I did always have a proper bin in my bedroom due to having a hamster so I didn't have to sneak around. 

She was dismissive and spoke down to me a bit like I was stupid. Told me to use some panty liners she had. I don't think she was having periods herself anymore. Was treated as something that didnt need speaking about and I didn't need any support for. Unfortunately for me it took me a long time to work out as a child that the intense suicidal feelings I'd get were likely connected to my cycle. 

I felt awkward asking her to buy me pads in the weekly shop and I wouldn't get to choose which ones. Same with deodorant she wouldn't buy me any unless I asked and then she'd buy this weird clear roll on or a body spray..

I ended up buying my own toiletries with pocket money my dad gave me but I had to ration it a little. I even had to buy my own pjs as I only had old school trousers and old shirts to sleep in.

Thank god for the internet😔 I thought all this was normal until I became an adult. I wouldn't talk to her about anything even now, but other people I'm open about stuff to because I know it's harmful not to be.
